endorsements.quote: Developers must prioritize diversity and inclusivity in dataset curation to ensure equitable performance across various patient populations.
Policymakers and healthcare organizations must also invest in digital literacy programs to empower patients to effectively utilize these tools.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tune LLMs for patient education on curated datasets of peer-reviewed literature, clinical guidelines, and real-world patient interactions.
Integrate case-based scenarios into LLM training to help models handle atypical presentations and rare complications.
Evaluate LLM patient education outputs with metrics beyond Likert scales and readability scores, such as Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and specificity scores.
Use qualitative methods such as patient focus groups and clinician feedback to evaluate LLM-generated patient education content.
Integrate LLMs into clinical decision support systems so clinicians can generate personalized patient education in real time while remaining the final arbiter of content.
Conduct pilot studies of LLM-CDSS integration assessing patient satisfaction, treatment adherence, and clinical outcomes.
Implement safeguards to protect patient confidentiality when LLMs are integrated into electronic health record systems.
Develop multilingual and offline-compatible versions of LLM patient education tools to broaden accessibility.

screen.reason: This is a letter/commentary discussing the potential, ethical considerations, and recommendations for deploying large language models as patient education tools in inflammatory bowel disease.
